class.name: VehicleData
class.description: Which vehicle of the catalogue it is ([code]VehicleCatalogServer[/code]), in which livery, what it is in the trainset and how it stands. A provider's subclass keeps what it knows of it besides.

method.name: take_vehicle_of
method.description: The entry becomes the vehicle [param other] is, in its livery, turned the way [param other] is.

members.member: Its coupling with the next vehicle of the trainset, a mask of [code]RailVehicleController.CouplingFlags[/code].
Reversed in its trainset or not.
How far it stands behind the vehicle before it [m].
The name of its livery; empty for the provider's default.
Its name for the player to read - the resource's own ([member Resource.resource_name]); none shows the [member vehicle_id].
In a trainset as the player arranged it: its place in the trainset as the scenery declares it, front first, by which it is paired with its declared vehicle; -1: a vehicle added to it.
What the provider finds the vehicle by.
The vehicle's id, what finds it; may be empty or repeated.
The name of the provider the vehicle is the one of; empty for the project's default.
The velocity it starts with [km/h] - its trainset's, along the track; a reversed vehicle takes it negated.

constants.constant: Nobody - the vehicle is not driven at all.
A driver in its front cab.
A driver in its rear cab.
